decisionSummary: Bureau Doc 2.0.39 fixes two owner-reported defects, both of them wiring that was never completed rather than behaviour that broke. First, a document came back empty after a restart: backend/server.js passed a persistence option to y-websocket's setupWSConnection, whose signature destructures docName and gc only and silently drops every other key, so the option configured nothing, no error was raised anywhere, rooms synced live between connected clients, and not one byte was written. Persistence is module state and is now registered once via setPersistence() against the LevelDB handle the grain already owns. Second, the font dropdown restyled the whole document because it set a React state variable that a useEffect wrote onto a CSS custom property; a local TipTap FontFamily extension on the textStyle mark Color already rides now applies the typeface to the selection, and the choice lives in the Y.Doc so it survives a reload and reaches collaborators. The commit message on this exact dev-publish tip records both measurements and the mutations run against every guard. Main remains the reviewed baseline; the dev-publish head is the release authority, as for every other row in this catalog.

checks: clean detached checkout at the selected canonical dev-publish commit

the persistence guard drives the real y-websocket binding against a real LevelDB and reads the bytes back through a SECOND handle — the disk is the assertion, because the wrong call and the right call are indistinguishable to review and to the compiler
its control proves the same edit is LOST with no binding registered, so the test cannot pass because something else happens to be writing
mutation: restoring the ignored persistence option fails the shipped-call-site guard by name; removing the setPersistence registration fails it by name
the font guard runs headless against the real ProseMirror schema and asserts on the document, not on rendered HTML, so 'only the selected range is marked' is checked where it is a fact
mutation: reverting the dropdown to the React state setter, dropping the attribute from textStyle, and rendering a style for a null font each fail by name
the client bundle was rebuilt and the stale asset removed, so the shipped frontend carries the fix rather than the source alone
receipt regenerated from git ls-remote at publish time by scripts/refresh-source-selection.py, not hand-transcribed
